name: Memoria v0.5.0
body:
## English

### Read this first: a correction

**The S1-S5 code was not written for this release.**

It was written earlier the same day (01:29-12:13) and **had already been packed into the 0.4.7 and 0.4.8
installers**, because withdrawing the earlier 0.5.0 only reverted the version number and never reverted
the code. Measured evidence:

| version | agent tool surface | `outline`/`section`/`snippet` | ships `mcp_server.py` |
|---|---|---|---|
| v0.4.6 | about 65 | absent | no |
| **v0.4.7** | **about 69** | **active** | yes |
| **v0.4.8** | **about 69** | **active** | yes |

So anyone upgrading 0.4.6 -> 0.4.7 gained four agent tools **with no mention in the release notes**.
That is "did the work, said nothing" — the mirror image of the earlier "said it, did nothing", and equally
serious: **the version number stopped describing the actual content**. Correction notices were added to
the 0.4.7 and 0.4.8 releases, and this release formally ratifies the fact.

### Theme: agent capability architecture — encapsulated, interfaced, extensible, traceable

Five phases, each independently accepted, each with deliberately-broken fixtures proving the guards
really reject.

**S1 three-level granular reads** — `outline` (heading tree), `section` (one section's body),
`snippet` (hit window), plus a new `replace_section` write op that reuses the single existing writer
chain rather than adding a new writer. On a real 229-document / 2.59 MB corpus: **91.70% addressable**,
2.62% fence misclassification, 2.93% duplicate headings. Hard conditions C1-C5 (strip fences and
frontmatter; dual-anchor disambiguation; ambiguity must return `AMBIGUOUS_SECTION` and **never take the
first candidate**; `#L<line>` as a first-class fallback; level ranges pinned). Read/write mixed usage
saved **77.81% tokens** (92.43% for pure reads; the mixed figure is the more honest one), at the cost of
**50% more turns** (12 -> 18).

**S2 four write-safety gates** — W1 single entry point (`origin` mandatory, signature-level fail-closed,
omitting it is a `TypeError`); W2 read-before-write guard (granular reads feed the observation table;
before this, granularisation made mixed read/write **17.09% more expensive**); W3 pre-write backup
(backup failure means zero writes, byte-exact rollback); W4 pre-dispatch approval (even core write
capabilities declare it). The contract document was rewritten to state **"not idempotent"** honestly
instead of promising idempotency.

**S3 thin MCP binding** — a hand-written, zero-new-dependency, stateless server (703 lines) aligned to
the official 2026-07-28 schema (`server/discover` MUST plus `tools/list` and `tools/call`, error codes
`-32022` / `-32601` / `-32700`). Minimal tool-set schema is **544 tokens** against a 1450 budget.
Cross-process W2 uses the spec's standard answer SEP-2567 `read_handle` bound to (file, sha256).
**It has not been tested against a real MCP client**, registered as a limitation.

**S4 extension points** — third parties can add tools **without changing the core** (declarative
`provides.tools[].impl` plus a single generic `SubprocessTool` adapter; the core never names a concrete
tool). Timeouts really kill the process (30s budget, 1s case measured at 1.02s); output is really
truncated (512 KiB -> 262,198 bytes); with no plugins the 39 tools are item-for-item unchanged.
`gate`/`constrain` were moved out of v1 after measuring **0% coverage** (15 declarations, all trivially
true `always`). **Extension tools are not a sandbox** and sit outside the W1 writer chain.

**S5 trace across boundaries** — per-call cost fields (`est_tokens`, `truncated`, `approval`,
`write{txid, plus/minus lines, undo}`). **Hard privacy boundary**: message bodies are stored only as a
digest, a length, and the first 256 characters — with a falsifiable assertion built from a secret marker
placed after character 256. Capacity 6000 -> 5000 with **100% retention of error and write-path entries**.
`trace_cost_summary` aggregates with zero error. MCP `_meta` carries three OpenTelemetry keys so a
cross-process `trace_id` shares one trace with the in-process write path.

### R1-level re-acceptance (why it had to be redone)

The five original acceptances were performed on **older commits** (S2 at `570ccf6c`, S4 at `7c4818fd`,
S5 at `512513a7`), while 0.4.7 and 0.4.8 changed shared files (`session/history.py`, `compaction.py`,
`ask.py`, `ui.py`), so **the old conclusions could not be reused**. Re-proven at the current HEAD:
```
five prior acceptances re-checked clause by clause    all still hold (2 items need disclosure)
all acceptance fixtures re-run                       per-command, exit code, key assertions
deliberately-broken fixtures re-proven               W1 default origin -> red (missing origin no longer TypeError)
                                                     S5 privacy PREVIEW_CHARS 256->10000 -> red
                                                       (the secret marker really did leak into trace)
                                                     S1 remove ambiguity refusal -> red (took first candidate)
                                                     all restored, git diff -- src/ empty
12 interaction scenarios                             12/12
full pytest                                          1474 passed / 0 failed
```

One assumption was corrected: the Lead suspected that task-91 adding `context_usage` made the S2
contract document stale. Verification showed `agent-service-contract.md` scopes itself to the **write**
service contract and does not cover session RPC; `context_usage` actually belongs in
`dsh-agent-port.md` section 6, where it was indeed missing. The distinction matters because the owner
and the fix differ.

### Known debts (registered, not falsely closed)
S1's **turn-level completion rate is unproven** (token savings already prove retrieval sufficiency; the
completion rate needs a real task set, which needs a real LLM endpoint, so it is an explicit follow-up);
the `section_headings_census` baseline snapshot is stale (229 -> 238 docs, unrelated fields still pass
proving the algorithm is intact); `context_usage` is now registered in `dsh-agent-port.md` section 6;
S4 carries four known limitations; the 12 interaction scenarios cover selection/editing only and not
agent-panel interaction (a pre-existing gap, not introduced here).

## Cost (Agent compute)

- **Magnitude**: roughly **CNY 300-800** (estimate; not itemised).
- **Accounting basis**: **v0.4.7 ~ v0.5.0 counted as one block.** These three releases cannot be split
  per-version honestly: they share one continuous architecture effort, one acceptance chain, and one
  team session. Token-level accounting was never recorded, so the figure is estimated from session
  rounds and team size rather than metered.
- **Cost structure (one line)**: most of the spend went to **round-after-round real-machine
  verification and root-cause attribution**, not to writing code. In particular, chasing three
  separate "false completion" cases (dead code / born-dead wiring / broken measurement instrument)
  consumed the majority of it.

## 中文

**S1–S5 的代码不是本版新写的。**

它是在 2026-10-25 上午（01:29–12:13）就写进仓库的，而 **0.4.7（17:46）/ 0.4.8（18:22）打包时已经把它们一起打了进去** —— 因为当初撤销 0.5.0 时**只回退了版本号、没有回退代码**。

实测证据：

| 版本 | agent 工具面 | `outline`/`section`/`snippet` | 含 `mcp_server.py` |
|---|---|---|---|
| v0.4.6 | ≈ 65 把 | ❌ 无 | ❌ |
| **v0.4.7** | **≈ 69 把** | **✅ 已生效** | ✅ |
| **v0.4.8** | **≈ 69 把** | **✅ 已生效** | ✅ |

⇒ **从 0.4.6 升到 0.4.7 的用户，agent 的工具面多了 4 把，而当时 release notes 一个字没提。**

这是「**做了没说**」—— 与之前那些「说了没做」相反，但同样严重：**版本号不能描述实际内容**。

已同时给 0.4.7 / 0.4.8 的 Release body 补上更正声明。**本版即是对该事实的正式追认。**

---

## 主题：agent 能力架构重构 —— 有封装、有接口、可扩展、可追踪

五阶段，每阶段均经**独立验收**且带**必红夹具**证明守卫真会拒绝。

### S1 三级粒度读
`outline`（标题树）/ `section`（单节正文）/ `snippet`（命中窗口）+ 新增 `replace_section` 写 op（复用唯一写者链，**不新增写者**）。

真实语料 229 篇 / 2.59 MB 实测：**91.70% 可寻址**、2.62% 围栏误判、2.93% 重名。

C1–C5 硬条件：剔围栏+frontmatter / 双锚消歧 / 无法唯一必须 `AMBIGUOUS_SECTION` **不取首个** / `#L行号` 一等回退 / 级别范围写死。R-D2 正则统一（h1 提案 0 → 279）。

**读写混合实测省 77.81% token**（纯读 92.43%，混合口径更诚实），**代价轮数 +50%**（12→18 次）。

### S2 写安全四道闸
| 闸 | 机制 |
|---|---|
| **W1** 入口唯一 | `origin` 必填，签名级 fail-closed，漏传 = `TypeError` |
| **W2** 读后写守卫 | 粒度读已喂观察表（修复前读写混合下粒度化**反而贵 17.09%**） |
| **W3** 写前备份 | 失败零写入，逐字节撤销 |
| **W4** 分发前审批 | 核心写能力也有声明位 |

契约文档重写：§4 **如实写「不幂等」**，而不是承诺幂等。

### S3 MCP 薄绑定
手写**零新依赖**无状态 server（703 行），对齐官方 `2026-07-28` schema
（`server/discover` MUST + `tools/list` + `tools/call`，`-32022` / `-32601` / `-32700`）。
最小工具集 schema **544 tok**（预算 1450）。跨进程 W2 用 spec 标准答案 SEP-2567 `read_handle` 绑 `(文件, sha256)`。

⚠️ **未与真实 MCP 客户端对拍**，登记为限制。

### S4 扩展点
第三方**不改核心**即可加工具（声明式 `provides.tools[].impl` + 唯一通用 `SubprocessTool` 适配器，核心零具体工具名）。
超时真杀进程（30s 预算 / 1s 实测 1.02s）、输出真截断（512KiB → 262198B）、无插件时 39 把工具逐项不变。

`gate` / `constrain` **移出 v1**（实测覆盖率 **0%**：15 处声明全写恒真 `always`）。

⚠️ **扩展工具不是沙箱**，在 W1 写者链之外。

### S5 trace
调用级成本字段（`est_tokens` / `truncated` / `approval` / `write{txid,±lines,undo}`）。

**隐私硬边界**：正文只存 digest + 长度 + 首 256 字符 —— 用第 256 字符后的**秘密标记做可证伪断言**。

容量 6000 → 5000 且**错误 / 写路径条目 100% 保留**；`trace_cost_summary` 聚合误差 0；
MCP `_meta` OTel 三键 ⇒ 跨进程 `trace_id` 与进程内写路径共享同一 trace。

---

## R1 级重验收（为什么必须重做）

五份旧验收是在**旧 commit** 上做的（S2 `570ccf6c` / S4 `7c4818fd` / S5 `512513a7`），
而 0.4.7 / 0.4.8 改过共享文件（`session/history.py`、`compaction.py`、`ask.py`、`ui.py`）
⇒ **旧结论不能沿用**。已在当前 HEAD `093dac0e` 重新证明：

```
五份旧验收逐条复核    全部仍成立（2 处需知悉，见已知债务）
全部验收夹具重跑      逐条命令 + 退出码 + 断言输出
必红夹具重证明        W1 origin 加默认值 → 红（漏传不再 TypeError）
                     S5 隐私 PREVIEW_CHARS 256→10000 → 红（秘密标记真的漏进 trace）
                     S1 去掉歧义拒绝 → 红（取首个而非报错）
                     改坏后均还原，git diff -- src/ 为空
12 交互剧本           12/12
全量 pytest          1474 passed / 0 failed
```

**一个被修正的假设**：Lead 曾怀疑「task-91 加 `context_usage` ⇒ S2 契约文档过期」。
验收者查证后修正：`agent-service-contract.md` 声明范围是**写服务契约**，不含会话 RPC；
`context_usage` 的真实归属是 `dsh-agent-port.md` §6 —— 那里确实零命中（真实缺口），
但**不是"S2 契约文档过期"**。两者责任归属和修法不同。

---

## 已知债务（登记，不假装关闭）

| # | 债务 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| ① | **S1「完成率未证」** | token 侧已证检索充分性；完成率需**真机任务集**（下一阶段），需真实 LLM 端点 ⇒ 不花用户额度，登记为显式待办 |
| ② | `section_headings_census` 基线快照过期 | 229 → 238 docs（用户库新增 80 个未跟踪 .md）；**与内容无关字段仍 PASS** 证明 `scan_headings` 算法未坏 ⇒ 发版后刷基线 |
| ③ | `context_usage` 未登记进 `dsh-agent-port.md` §6 | 本版同批补 |
| ④ | S4 四条已知限制 | `gate` 覆盖率 0% / 扩展工具非沙箱 / 等 |
| ⑤ | 12 剧本覆盖缺口 | 只覆盖选区/编辑，不覆盖 agent 面板交互（既有缺口，非本版新增） |

## 造价

- **本版最大的成本不是开发，是"发现版本号在说谎"**：S1–S5 上午就写完了，下午发了两版都没提。
  要不是你问「你0.5.0做了什么为什么要跳到0.5.x」，这个问题会一直挂着。
- **重验收的代价**：五份旧验收 + 必红夹具 + 12 剧本全部重跑，因为**验收的树不是要发的树**。
- **一个结构性教训**：*撤销一个版本时，要撤销的不只是版本号*。
  只回退版本号而留下代码 ⇒ 后续每个版本都在" secretly 携带"上一个版本的内容，
  而 release notes 越来越不描述实际内容。
- **本版真正的产出**：让版本号重新变得可信。

**完整变更**：[`docs/conventions/version.md`](docs/conventions/version.md) · **验收报告**：[`artifacts/agent/verify/todo/0.5.0-acceptance-reverify.md`](artifacts/agent/verify/todo/0.5.0-acceptance-reverify.md)

## 造价（Agent 算力）

- **量级**：约 **300–800 元人民币**（估算，非逐项计量）。
- **统计口径**：**v0.4.7 ~ v0.5.0 合并统计**。这三版无法诚实切分到单版：它们共享同一条连续的
  架构工作线、同一条验收链、同一个团队会话；且 token 级台账从未记录，故按会话轮次与团队规模估算，
  不是计量值。
- **成本结构（一句话）**：主要花在**逐轮真机验证与根因归因**，不是写代码。其中追查三起独立的
  「假完成」（死代码 / 出生即死接线 / 量具盲区）占了大头。
